title: Sequence, Input and Output
intro: Independent catch-up for the Autumn 2 coding sequence. Work through the model, test ideas and self-mark at the end.

stages.label: Learn
stages.lead: Read the teaching points and worked code.

blocks.title: Sequence
blocks.text: Instructions execute in order, starting with input before output.

blocks.title: Input
blocks.text: Store the user's response using name = input("Name?").

blocks.title: Output
blocks.text: print(name) displays the stored response; print("name") displays literal text.

blocks.title: Test
blocks.text: Predict for one input, test another, and correct errors.

blocks.title: Learning sequence
blocks.caption: Input must happen before the value is used.

blocks.title: Worked program
blocks.text:
club = input("Club name?")
print(club)
If the response is Chess, the output is Chess.

items: Sequence — Instructions carried out in their written order.
Input — Data entered into a program, for example through input().
Output — Information shown by a program, for example using print().
Variable — A named place to store a value that can be used later.
Trace — Following executed instructions to work out values and output.
